adjudication.rationale: The diff adds sendAddGuestsEmails() in packages/emails/email-manager.ts which (1) always sends an OrganizerAddGuestsEmail to the organizer and each team member (lines adding OrganizerAddGuestsEmail + team.members loop), and (2) iterates over calendarEvent.attendees and sends an email for every attendee on each add-guests call. In addGuests.handler.ts, evt.attendees is built from bookingAttendees.attendees (i.e., the full accumulated attendee list after the update), and the new email templates generate an ICS payload from the full calEvent (see attendee-add-guests-email.ts and organizer-add-guests-email.ts calling generateIcsString({ event: this.calEvent, ... })). That means each call sends O(A) emails each embedding an ICS containing O(A) attendee data, yielding an O(A^2) scaling concern as attendees grow. This is a real, diff-grounded performance/operational cost issue, but not a correctness defect per se.
